 You don't have to wait until Nov. 27. Amazon, Best Buy, HexClad and more already have Black Friday deals live.
 Kasey Caminiti USA TODAY Nov. 20, 2026, 2:52 p.m. ET Hear this story Black Friday is officially one week away, but if you're waiting until Nov. 27 to start shopping, you could be missing some of the biggest sales of the season.
 This weekend is shaping up to be a major Black Friday shopping moment all on its own. Amazon and Best Buy officially launched their Black Friday events on Nov. 19 , while Zenni's sale starts today, Nov. 20 . HexClad , The Home Depot and Lowe's are also offering Black Friday savings right now.
 Translation? This is the weekend to start checking off that holiday shopping list.
 I've rounded up 10 of the Black Friday sales worth knowing about right now, whether you're hunting for Apple tech, cookware, power tools, prescription glasses, holiday gifts or a much-needed home upgrade.
 1. Amazon Black Friday sale
 Sale dates: Nov. 19 through Nov. 30
 Amazon's Black Friday Week is officially underway, with millions of deals scheduled across electronics, toys, fashion, beauty, home and more. Amazon says shoppers can expect discounts from brands including Samsung, Bose, Anker, Lego, Hasbro, Medicube and Levi's.
 Don't miss out! Get weekly deals, trends and product recommendations from USA TODAY Shopping delivered straight to your inbox. Shop Amazon's Black Friday sale More: Amazon's Black Friday sale has millions of deals. Here's what to buy first 2. Best Buy Black Friday tech sale
 Sale dates: Nov. 19 through Nov. 28
 Shopping for tech? Best Buy's official Black Friday sale is live with 10 days of Doorbusters across laptops, TVs, headphones, Apple products, appliances and more.
 There are some genuinely attention-grabbing prices here. Best Buy is offering a TCL 65-inch TV for $229.99 , an HP OmniBook 5 OLED laptop for $449.99 , Sony noise-canceling headphones for $169 and $300 off the Shark PowerDetect Speed Cordless Stick Vacuum Cleaner . 
 Shop Best Buy's Black Friday sale More: When do Best Buy Black Friday deals start? Here’s what to know 3. HexClad Black Friday cookware sale
 Sale dates: Now through Dec. 2
 The HexClad Black Friday sale has discounts of up to 52% off cookware , kitchen essentials and bundles.
 One of the biggest-ticket savings is the best-selling 12-Piece Hybrid Pots & Pans Set , marked down from $999 to $599, a $400 discount.
 HexClad 12-Piece Hybrid Pots & Pans Set Save a whopping $400 on this bestselling 12-piece cookware set, now $599 instead of $999, featuring versatile pots and pans for everything from quick breakfasts to hearty family dinners. Save 40% at HexClad More: I can't believe I just found 52% off Gordon Ramsay-loved HexClad cookware 4. The Home Depot Black Friday sale
 Sale dates: Black Friday savings available now
 The Home Depot is one of my favorite Black Friday destinations because the deals stretch well beyond gifts. Think power tools, appliances, smart-home gear, Christmas decorations and winter project supplies.
 Right now, shoppers can find up to 45% off select tools, including BOGO offers on brands like Milwaukee and up to $1,250 off select appliances , according to The Home Depot's Black Friday hub.
 Homeowners, DIYers and anyone shopping for a very particular dad should start here.
 Shop The Home Depot Black Friday deals More: The Home Depot is giving away free Ryobi tools for Black Friday 5. Zenni Black Friday sale
 Sale dates: Nov. 20 through Nov. 29
 Need a new pair of glasses? Zenni's sale is officially live , making it one of this weekend's freshest Black Friday deals.
 Use promo code BFS to save 20% on orders of $99 or more, 25% on $150 or more or 30% on $215 or more . The promotion runs through Nov. 29 and applies to qualifying full-price merchandise.
 The tiered promotion makes the most sense if you're ordering multiple pairs or adding prescription lens upgrades. I'd use this opportunity to grab an everyday pair plus prescription sunglasses or a spare set rather than padding an order just to reach the next discount threshold.
 Save at Zenni's Black Friday sale More: Zenni’s holiday sale is here, and these are the frames I’d buy 6. Lowe's Black Friday sale
 Sale dates: Black Friday savings underway now
 Lowe's got a four-week head start on Black Friday, launching holiday savings back on Oct. 29 across tools, appliances , holiday décor and outdoor equipment.
 We're now in one of the more interesting parts of the promotion because Lowe's 12 Days of Deals started Nov. 16, bringing new savings opportunities each day ahead of Black Friday. Even bigger Thanksgiving-week offers are still to come.
 MyLowe’s Rewards and MyLowe’s Pro Rewards members can get additional benefits during the season, too, including early access to Black Friday Doorbusters and free same-day delivery on eligible purchases.
 Shop Black Friday deals at Lowe's More: Lowe’s 4 weeks of Black Friday deals start now with extra member perks 7. Wayfair Black Friday sale
 Sale dates: Live now
 Hosting Thanksgiving and suddenly realizing your dining room needs...everything? Wayfair has officially entered the Black Friday chat.
 Wayfair's Black Friday sale is live with up to 80% off select furniture, décor, rugs, bedding and other home finds, with free shipping advertised as part of the event.
 This is one sale where I wouldn't shop by discount percentage alone. Pay attention to dimensions, materials, reviews and delivery timing, especially for larger furniture purchases. If Thanksgiving delivery isn't possible, focus on longer-term upgrades for your living room, bedroom or home office.
 Save up to 80% at Wayfair 8. Groupon Black Friday sale
 Sale dates: Early Black Friday through Nov. 22
 Don't forget about experiences when you're Black Friday shopping. Groupon's early Black Friday event runs through Sunday, Nov. 22 , with savings on everything from spas and beauty services to local attractions, escape rooms, shows, tours and getaways.
 One of my personal favorite Groupon offers? For a limited time, you can get a one-year Gold Star Costco membership on Groupon for $65 and receive a $45 Costco Shop Card to use on future purchases at any Costco location or online.
 Groupon deal: One-year Costco membership Take advantage of this Groupon offer on Costco memberships. Join now to get a Shop Card to use on future purchases at Costco. Join Costco and get $45 back More: Top Black Friday membership deals at Sam’s Club, Costco and Amazon 9. Dooney & Bourke Black Friday sale
 Sale dates: Live now
 Designer handbags can get pricey fast, which is why Dooney & Bourke's Black Friday event immediately caught my attention. The heritage accessories brand's holiday promotion is offering up to 40% off select styles , giving shoppers a chance to save on handbags, wallets and other leather accessories ahead of the holidays.
 There are significant markdowns on several classic silhouettes. Current sale listings include the Pebble Grain Crossbody 25 for $129, down from $258 , and the Florentine Mini Satchel for $329, down from $478 .
 Shop Dooney & Bourke bags starting at $99 10. Reolink Black Friday 2026 deals: Save up to 37% on OMVI cameras
 Sale dates: Now through Nov. 30
 Reolink's Black Friday and Cyber Monday sale takes up to 37% off OMVI outdoor security cameras , with sale prices starting at $159.99. Better yet, the cameras support local storage without requiring shoppers to pay for a monthly subscription.
 OMVI 2i Ultra : $159.99 , down from $229.99, 30% off
 OMVI 3i PoE : $219.99 , down from $349.99, 37% off
 OMVI 3i Wi-Fi : $229.99 , down from $349.99, 34% off
 OMVI X16 PoE : $475.99 , down from $679.99, 30% off
 Save up to 37% on outdoor security cameras More: Outdoor security cameras with no subscription fees? Save 37% today Black Friday sales to watch
 Kohl's Black Friday sale : Nov. 22 through Nov. 28
 Target Black Friday sale : Nov. 22 through Nov. 29
 Walmart Black Friday sale : Nov. 23 through Nov. 29
 When is Black Friday 2026?
 Black Friday is Friday, Nov. 27, 2026 , the day after Thanksgiving. Many major retailers are starting their sales considerably earlier.
 What stores have Black Friday sales right now?
 As of Nov. 20, major Black Friday promotions are already underway at Amazon, Best Buy, HexClad, The Home Depot, Lowe's and Zenni .
 USA TODAY Shopping will be covering all the best deals, so be sure to follow us on TikTok , check us out on Flipboard , sign up for our newsletter and follow us on Instagram to stay updated!
